title: Value-add project
description: Work applied to an asset to change what it earns or what it is worth. Generic: a renovation, a repositioning, a change of use or a redevelopment are all value-add projects. Costs are scenario-based ranges with explicit confidence, because a figure inferred from listing photographs is not a quote.

project_type.description: Domain-defined, e.g. renovation, repositioning, change_of_use, compliance_upgrade.

scenario.description: Domains name these; the japan_ski_property module maps them to minimum viable / good lodge standard / premium repositioning.

line_items.description: Component costs. Ranges, not point estimates, unless a real quote exists.

basis.description: inferred_from_images is the weakest basis and must never be reported as a firm cost.

contingency_percent.description: Explicit contingency. Mountain and heritage construction routinely exceeds estimates.

overall_confidence.description: Confidence in the whole estimate. Reported alongside every figure derived from it.

unlocks_compliance.description: Whether this project is what makes lawful commercial operation possible. If true, the project is not optional.
